_notice: Official Freedom Broker checklist. Criterion ids, names, weights and allowed values are copied from the CQA guide appendix (Формат JSON 1.0, стр. 3). Wording and N/A rules are left empty on purpose: they are in the separate checklist PDF, which is not in the repository. Do not invent them here. At start-up ATLAS creates the checklist 'Freedom Broker — Official CQA Checklist' from this file once (version 1); editing this file later does not change that checklist.
name: Freedom Broker — Official CQA Checklist
description: The eight official criteria with their weights, answer types and allowed values from the CQA guide appendix (JSON 1.0). Add each criterion's wording and N/A rule from the official checklist PDF.
source: CQA Hackathon, приложение к студенческому гайду «Как сдать результаты», стр. 3 «Правила заполнения» (Формат JSON 1.0)
notes: value: true = «Да», false = «Нет», null = N/A. A number is the score on the criterion's scale before weighting: dialogue = 7 means 7 of 10 at weight 15.
final_score: 0 to 100, rounded to two decimals. An N/A criterion is excluded and its weight is redistributed proportionally over the applicable criteria. N/A is not zero and not a processing error.
critical_flag equals the value of criterion 'critical'; true means a gross violation was found. It is reported separately and does not zero the total.
The appendix does not name a rounding mode; the template uses half-up.
The appendix defines no sections, so the template has none.
